The organization regularly creates safe spaces and provisions for education at risk children to continue their schooling and also provides vocational training to become self-reliant.
The organization follows two interventions to eliminate the sources of trafficking; firstly, providing education to at-risk children, equipping themselves with skills to ensure a bright future, and motivating their mothers to live life with dignity and decent job opportunities. Secondly creating awareness among the public to safeguard women’s dignity and self-esteem.
